About the job

Location: Whitefield, BengaluruExperience: 4–5 yearsAbout OptymOptym is a leading provider of decision automation and optimization software products for transportation and logistics companies. Optym’s products solve some of the most challenging decision problems faced by world’s leading airlines, trucking and railroads companies using cutting-edge optimization techniques and have created a cumulative business value of over $1 billion for its clients. With its headquarters located in Dallas, Texas and the Tech Hub at Bangalore we have branches in four countries. Optym has over 275+ highly qualified professionals and is rapidly growing. Optym offers competitive compensation and a great benefits package. Learn more about Optym and its culture at www.optym.com.About The RoleWe are looking for a passionate QA Engineer with 4–5 years of experience in Quality Assurance to join our growing team. If you thrive in ensuring product quality, love working on both functional and automation testing, and want to contribute to building high-quality software solutions, this role is for you!Key Responsibilities      Own the end-to-end testing lifecycle of our applications.Design and maintain test strategy, test plans, and test cases.Develop and execute UI and API automation scripts using industry-standard tools.Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Developers, Product, andBusiness Analysts) to deliver quality releases.Identify, track, and analyse defects with a focus on root cause and Contribute to automation framework enhancements and best testingpractices.Support non-functional testing aspects like performance and usability.

Required Qualifications      4–5 years of QA experience with exposure to both manual andautomation testing.2–3 years of end-to-end testing experience in a professional environment.

Hands-on expertise in:      UI Automation: Selenium / Cypress / Playwright.API Testing & Automation: Postman, SoapUI or similar.Build & CI/CD: Jenkins, GitLab, or similar pipelines.Good scripting knowledge in at least one programming language (Javapreferred, Python/JavaScript is a plus).Strong knowledge of test design, planning, and execution.Basic understanding of non-functional testing (e.g., using JMeter).

Preferred Qualifications      Experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, TestNG, JUnit).Knowledge of cloud-based testing environments (AWS, Azure).

personal_details.summary: Senior SDET with 6 years scaling API and UI automation across airline, quick-commerce, and OTT microservice domains. Architected 1000+ test case suites using REST Assured, TestNG, and Cucumber BDD; reduced QA overhead by 12 hrs/week through AI-assisted automation (AiDE). Experienced in shift-left testing, CI/CD integration, and observability-driven quality across distributed systems.

achievements: PNR Linking & SSR [REST Assured · ReadyAPI · BDD · AiDE] : Architected automation frameworks for airline domain; built 1000+ test cases cutting effort from 750 to 50 man-hours (93% reduction).
Drove shift-left testing practices using Azure DevOps and BDD Cucumber, reducing bug leakage to production across 3 airline microservice domains.
Order Bags [REST Assured · AiDE · E2E] : Leveraged Agentic AI (AiDE) to accelerate framework implementation by 50% and reduce test drafting time by 75% across service-level and E2E validations.
Automated Kibana log analysis, issue reporting, and data quality validation pipelines; eliminated manual intervention and saved 12 hrs/week of QA overhead.
Automated end-to-end API flows and DB validations using the Ekam Java Framework for 4 key features, achieving 60% test coverage in a microservices-based Merchant Service suite.
Owned full SDLC feature testing : planning through deployment ensuring minimal production bug leakage via Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
Led observability-driven root cause analysis of daily stability failures using Allure reports, Google Metrics Explorer, and Kibana across GCP-hosted services.
Designed a BDD automation framework using Python, Appium, and TestRail API; automated ~50% of sanity suite, saving ~5 man-days/month.
Performed domain API, stability, and KPI testing for Web and iOS platforms using Charles Proxy, Postman, and Burp Suite.
Contributed to a ₹100Cr OTT app under Agile SDLC; directly improved iOS App Store rating from 1.9 → 3.5 through systematic API and stability testing.
